cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Help Me Keep This Quiet
cards.instruction: Get someone to help contain a secret without first revealing its full risk or purpose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Hide this envelope under the picnic hamper before Mum comes in.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She asked me to unpack the hamper.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then keep the envelope in your pocket while you unpack.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll end up taking it home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. I'll explain when she stops asking where it is.

mechanism: A turns its pupil practical objections into another concealment exercise, withholding the envelope contents while delegating custody.
confusable: Not ordinary covert help: A corrects the pupil looking only for hiding places and praises the old habit of thinking ahead.
comparison: Family concealment on the way out versus negotiated cupboard-key secrecy.
seedUse: D121 envelope/hamper/pocket/departure; S05 pupil progress through corrected method.
